parameters.name: AccountName
parameters.description: The name of the account to delete.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The region where the instance resides.

parameters.name: SecurityAccountName
parameters.description:
The name of the security administrator account.

> If three-role mode is enabled, this parameter is required. If three-role mode is not enabled, this parameter is not required.

parameters.name: SecurityAccountPassword
parameters.description:
The password of the security administrator account.

> If three-role mode is enabled, this parameter is required. If three-role mode is not enabled, this parameter is not required.
